cases.name: Melissa Nicole "Missy" Barto
cases.about: Her obituary said Missy was an avid Pittsburgh sports fan and enjoyed concerts, drawing and hanging out with her friends. She especially loved and enjoyed spending time with daughter Lexee.
cases.narrative: Her body was found dumped in a field.
